label: late "u" input in sequences starting with "i"
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.01% of steps) that fires only in the original phase and at the delimiter, at late positions (t = 5..8), almost entirely in sequences whose first token is "i" (89% of activation mass; a little in g- or l-initial sequences). The strongest activations (near max) are on input "u" at orig positions 5-7 of i-initial sequences, especially when the second token is h, l or i. Weaker activations land on other late original tokens and on <DEL> in i-initial sequences. It never fires in the copy phase or at t < 4. The predicate (i-initial, input u, t >= 5) gets dev F1 0.33 and mass recall 0.53. Precision is limited because many i...u sequences do not fire, which suggests it also depends on the intervening tokens in a way I could not capture. Recall is limited by the weak non-u, i-initial activations.
